description: Pseudo-Arachnids - insectoid alien species organized in hive minds controlled by Brain Bugs. They possess advanced tunneling capabilities and formidable combat units.

unit_types.name: Warrior Bug
unit_types.description: Basic combat unit - four-legged spider-like creatures 2-3 meters in length. Primary frontline fighters.

variants.name: Desert Warrior
variants.color: Beige with yellow and black stripes

unit_types.name: Worker Bug
unit_types.description: Non-combat unit used for construction and tunnel maintenance. No offensive capability.

unit_types.name: Heavy Weapon - Beam
unit_types.description: Arachnid heavy weapon that fires energy beams at medium range.

unit_types.name: Heavy Weapon - Missile
unit_types.description: Arachnid heavy weapon that fires missiles at long range.

unit_types.name: Tanker Bug
unit_types.description: Large, heavily armored bug that can tunnel beneath enemies and appear behind lines. Orange coloration.

unit_types.name: Crawler Bug
unit_types.description: Massive siege unit with heavy armor and powerful weapons. Very slow but devastating.

unit_types.name: Plasma Bug
unit_types.description: Fires plasma projectiles at enemy units. High damage but slow reloading.

unit_types.name: Brain Bug (Master Brain)
unit_types.description: The hive mind controller - immobile but essential. Located at the center of the complex. Capturing it is a key objective.
unit_types.special: Must be protected at all costs. Located in the center hex of the Arachnid complex.

unit_types.name: Queen Bug
unit_types.description: Reproductive unit of the hive. High value target.

unit_types.name: Royal Warrior
unit_types.description: Elite bodyguard for Brain Bugs and Queens. Purple coloration. Essentially invulnerable - eyes must be blasted out first to access nerve stem.

unit_types.name: Strong Point
unit_types.description: Defensive fortification around the Arachnid complex.

unit_types.name: Decoy
unit_types.description: Fake unit used to deceive the Terran player about Bug positions.

special_markers.name: Perimeter Marker
special_markers.description: Marks the perimeter of the Arachnid complex

special_markers.name: Breach Marker
special_markers.description: Marks where bugs have surfaced from tunnels

special_markers.name: Radiation Area Marker
special_markers.description: Marks areas affected by nuclear weapons

special_markers.name: Tunnel Movement Counter
special_markers.description: Tracks underground movement of Bug units

hive_complex.description: The underground Arachnid hive is hidden from the Terran player. The Arachnid player uses an Alien Control Pad (small paper copy of the map) to track positions.
